content.short: Glacis Labs builds ZeroDelta, a clearinghouse for moving RWAs and digital assets across 40+ chains.
content.description: Glacis Labs builds ZeroDelta, a clearinghouse that matches institutional order flow so tokenized real-world assets and stablecoins can move across more than 40 chains with compliant, zero-slippage execution, reporting over $1 billion settled. Both Plasma's and Stable's official ecosystem pages list Glacis.
content.meta: Glacis Labs builds ZeroDelta, a cross-chain clearinghouse for RWAs, listed on Plasma and Stable.
